subject: Social Studies
questionText: The image shows a prominent ruler from a period in North India's history. After the death of this ruler, his vast empire was divided into small independent states. Which period in Indian history is associated with the rise of these small independent states?
questionImageBrief: A portrait of Emperor Harshvardhan, depicted as a regal figure with a turban and ornate clothing.
explanation: The text states, 'In the 7th century, after the death of Harshvardhana, his vast empire was divided into small independent states in North India... This period of the middle age is called the Rajput era in the Indian History.'

subject: Social Studies
instruction: Put the following rulers of the Chauhan dynasty in the correct order of their succession.

items.text: Vasudev founded the Chahman or Chauhan dynasty.
Ajayraj sat on the throne of Shakambhari and established Ajaymeru.
Someshwar Chauhan came to the throne.

explanation: The text states, "Vasudev was the founder of the Chahman or Chauhan dynasty of Shakambhari. In the beginning of the twelth century, Ajayraj sat on the throne of Shakambhari... After him, his son Someshwar Chauhan came to the throne. He was succeeded by his son Prithviraj III."
